ck: tatvaprakasikavivrti natva srisan kurun sarvan kururacoktanarkata tatvaprakasikakutapavan vaksye yatanati palasatanatasityatipalakatvapavat nanu sutrarta ityatra sutrasaptena vyakaranasutraneva pava purusarto pavatiti sucita iti pakavatprasatasya noksahetutve atasaptena sanksepata ukta ityarta visistakunanapyacasta iti atra kunasapto kunotirnatva–tosavacitatva–cneyatva–kanyatva rupatarnapara
